milestone: ABSOLUTE RECORD on the true 5.0/5.0 exact-clearance contract: 159.150 mm, from 164.042 - a 4.892 mm move, and the largest single-mechanism improvement recorded on this branch

mechanism.name: mode-26 clamped-sheet ladder compression with the GLOBAL PRESSURE-BALANCED LEGALIZATION fourth repair tier, cascaded and then jointly fixpointed against mode-22 alternation
mechanism.step1: the mode-26 rung runs the clamped separator, which compresses the layout past the rung bound into a state that carries a handful of clearance violations
mechanism.step2: the three local repair tiers - projection, conflict-targeted re-placement, joint per-component re-placement - each refuse it, exactly as the per-component beam certified they must: the violation component's own pieces have no in-bound pose
mechanism.step3: tier four makes the translation of EVERY piece a variable, linearizes each pair's separation requirement around its exact closest-approach witness, adds sheet containment and the rung bound as hard constraints on all 61 pieces, and solves the resulting quadratic program for the minimum-norm correction by Hildreth's method - projected Gauss-Seidel on the dual. Pieces that violate nothing move to make room for pieces that do; the median publishing pass moves 57 of the 61.
mechanism.step4: the state is re-measured exactly, the constraint set regenerated from that measurement, and the round repeated under a trust radius; publication is the authoritative validator's call against the real request
mechanism.step5: the cascade loop feeds each publication back as the next ladder's parent, and mode-22 alternation is interleaved until neither mechanism moves the state
